messages:
Priya (AE): Hey team — need a quick deal-desk review. Prospective pilot: Mistral Analytics. Asking for 35% off hosted API for 3 months + net60 for PO. They’re a strategic analytics partner; potential 12‑month convert if pilot hits throughput targets.
Ethan (DealDesk): Can you paste the messed-up numbers and ARR look? Need ARR estimate, expected monthly tokens, and churn risk. Also attach the draft PO.
Priya (AE): ARR estimate = $72k ARR if they convert (projected). Pilot usage estimate ~3M tokens/day (text gen). Draft PO attached as: PO-MISTRAL-0306.pdf.
Maya (Finance Ops): Quick thoughts: 35% and net60 both increase risk. Standard pilot concession is up to 25% one‑time credit + 30 day payment. We can mix a percent credit + usage credits to keep revenue recognition clean.
Ethan (DealDesk): @Maya can we offer 25% off for 3 months + $5k onboarding credit instead? That keeps the published rate but gives them runway. If AE insists on net60, need AR signoff.
Priya (AE): Customer insists on net60 due to internal procurement cycles. They’re willing to sign a 12‑month conversion commitment after pilot. Could we condition approval on the signed commitment?
Carlos (Legal): We can add a conversion commitment clause. Need to flag: if net60 delays cash >60 days we should include an early termination clawback for credits. I can draft language.
Maya (Finance Ops): Approvals: Finance can approve up to 25% + onboarding credit. Anything >25% requires CFO signoff. Net60 requires AR/Credit team ok but Finance needs to track exposure.
Ethan (DealDesk): Customer tier: strategic partner. If Jane approves 30% one-off and net60 with a signed 12‑month conversion, can we close?
Jane (CFO): I can authorize up to 30% one-time credit conditioned on: 1) signed conversion commit (min 12 months) 2) PO received before pilot start 3) Billing held to Net30 for first invoice, Net60 only after we receive signed commitment and initial billing triggers. Also require Legal clawback clause.
Priya (AE): Understood — I’ll send the conversion agreement and ask Legal for the clause. Customer ok to sign.
Carlos (Legal): Drafted clause: "If Customer fails to execute conversion within 90 days of pilot completion, any credits applied during the pilot will be invoiced to Customer within 30 days of breach." Sharing doc: //link/to/draft-clawback v1
Maya (Finance Ops): Please add BillingBot note: account flagged for review and hold pending signed commit.
BillingBot: Account MISTRAL-001 flagged. Billing hold applied: PRE-BILLED_CREDITS_HOLD.
Ethan (DealDesk): Final ask: approve 30% one-time credit applied to first 3 months usage, $5k onboarding credit, conditional on signed 12-month conversion and Legal clawback clause. Net60 to be granted only after signed conversion.
Jane (CFO): Approved. 30% one-time credit + $5k onboarding credit, conditional on the items above. Finance Ops to track exposure and AR to confirm payment terms post-signature.
Priya (AE): Thanks all — will attach signed agreement when back. Closing note: moving to "deal-desk-closed" and routing to Ops for invoice setup. :tada:
